text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We must have done a lot of walking today because my throat is bone-dry as we head home. I take out my water bottle to quench my thirst.
choice_data_list: Plum kelp tea always tastes extra good when I drink it outdoors.
Plum kelp tea always tastes extra good when I drink it outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer, have you been drinking that tea regularly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ever since Nishino Flower taught me that plum kelp tea helps relieve fatigue, it's become a favorite of mine.
choice_data_list: I have. It's been a lifesaver.
I have. It's been a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm so grateful for all the tidbits of wisdom the neighborhood grannies taught me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmm, all kinds of stuff… I can show you if you like?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we embark on Nishino Flower's revitalization tour.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer? Doesn't gazing at flowers while sunbathing just boost your spirits?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay! All right, let's see what else we can do to unwind…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There! Let's go sit down on that bench!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower and I look out at the flowers from our seats.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… The fragrances of all those flowers are so soothing…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Gasp! I-I fell asleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh no! It's already evening… L-let's move on to the next spot!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Mmm, delicious… These dried persimmons are nice and sweet…
choice_data_list: This flavor sure brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It does for me too! One of the ladies in my neighborhood used to eat them with me outside the general store.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The nice clerk used to give us a few extra for free, too…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Well, it wasn't all that long ago, now that I think about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The homely, laid-back nature of Nishino Flower's tour fills me with a sense of timeless nostalgia, and I'm left thoroughly refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, I think that's all we have time for today. …How was my tour?
choice_data_list: It was fantastic. Thank you for such a great day out.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You see, um… I've always worried that I was different.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The things I enjoy aren't quite like the hobbies of everyone else my age…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But… I love taking it easy and spending my time peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: When I was younger, I really enjoyed simple things, like feeling the warmth of the sun while on a walk with a neighborhood granny.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The fact that I was able to share all those experiences with you…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Makes me happy as can be!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Teehee. But I still have a long ways to go, seeing how I fell asleep mid-tour and all…
choice_data_list: I feel bad not giving anything back.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer… Hehe! Thank you for saying so.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure I'll be able to show you even more next time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best for my considerate trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If things get any more relaxing than this, I think I'll be the one falling asleep next time… Still, I'm looking forward to her next tour.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What?! Don't be silly!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's always doing everything to support me… And I know I can be a handful at times!
choice_data_list: I'd like to thank you properly sometime.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm… Then I'll have to come up with an even more impressive way to thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We continue to debate who should be thanking whom the whole way home.
